page_title: BAR 1-0 SEV | Barcelona v Sevilla 29/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Sevilla.
90+3' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
90+3' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
90+2' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

90+2' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked. The ball goes out for a corner. Barcelona can continue in their attacking effort.
90+2' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
90+1' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) steps up to send the ball in.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Loic Bade (Sevilla) was quite harsh and Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
86' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) dinks a cross into the box from the free kick. However, the opposition defence thwarts the attack, preventing anyone from finishing.
86' Jesus Navas (Sevilla) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
84' Foul! Loic Bade (Sevilla) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
82' Jose Luis Mendilibar has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jesus Navas (Sevilla) replacing Juanlu Sanchez.
82' Substitution. Adria Pedrosa walks off the pitch and Suso (Sevilla) comes on as a substitute.
82' Substitution. Oriol Romeu (Barcelona) has come on for Lamine Yamal.
81' Marc-Andre ter Stegen (Barcelona) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
80' Marc-Andre ter Stegen (Barcelona) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
80' Sevilla are ruled offside.
80' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
79' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle for a foul after Ferran Torres (Barcelona) hacks down one of his opponents.
79' Corner kick. Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) is ready to send the ball into the box.

78' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The ball goes out of play. Sevilla are awarded a corner kick.
78' Fernando (Sevilla) trips an opposition player and Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias signals a foul.
76' 1 - 0 An unfortunate own goal is conceded by Sergio Ramos (Sevilla), who attempted to block the ball after a cross, but instead he sends it into the bottom right corner of his own goal.
75' The manager makes a subsitution with Marcos Acuna (Sevilla) coming on for Dodi Lukebakio.
75' Jose Luis Mendilibar prepares a substitution. Erik Lamela is replaced by Mariano Diaz (Sevilla).
74' Great ball in from Erik Lamela. Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) should really have done better with a close-range header, but he heads it a whisker wide of the right post.
73' The linesman raises his flag. Ferran Torres (Barcelona) is adjudged offside.
71' Substitution. Ferran Torres (Barcelona) replaces Joao Felix.
71' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) latches on to a pass inside the box and strikes the ball to the middle of the goal, but one of the defending players makes a goal-line clearance.
71' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

71' A pass lands at the feet of Gavi (Barcelona) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender. The ball goes behind for a corner. Barcelona will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
69' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona).
69' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. The ball is out of play. Barcelona win a corner kick.
67' Fernando (Sevilla) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows for a foul.
66' Jose Luis Mendilibar has decided to substitute Djibril Sow and he is replaced by Fernando (Sevilla).
66' A sweet pass inside the box gives Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance!

65' What a save from Marc-Andre ter Stegen! Djibril Sow (Sevilla) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
64' 11:8 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
64' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle for a foul.
64' The corner from Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) is intercepted by the defence.
63' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Alejandro Balde (Barcelona), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The referee points to the corner flag and Barcelona will take a corner.
63' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias signals.
62' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
62' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) connects with a cross and has an effort on goal from the edge of the box, but it ends somewhere in row Z.
61' Erik Lamela (Sevilla) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
61' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) whips in a cross from the corner, but Orjan Nyland is well positioned and punches the ball away.
60' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) outbattles his marker to get a close-range header in on goal from the corner, but a defender unwittingly blocks the ball as it looked set to find the net.
60' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) will deliver the corner kick.
60' Joao Felix (Barcelona) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Now Barcelona have a corner.
58' A cross into the box from Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) is cleared.
57' Ilkay Gundogan floats a good corner into the box that Gavi (Barcelona) gets on the end of, but his effort on goal scorches just over the bar.
57' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

56' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. The linesman points to the corner flag, Barcelona are going to take it.
55' Joao Felix is not given a chance to finish after receiving a sweet pass by Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona).
55' Barcelona are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
54' Direct free kick. Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) attempts to beat the opposition's defence with a fine lofted pass into the penalty box, but one of the defenders reacts well and averts the threat.
53' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Sevilla was in an offside position.
52' The game has begun to heat up. Erik Lamela (Sevilla) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
52' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
52' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle for an infringement.
50' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias shows a yellow card to Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) for his blatant foul.
50' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) receives the ball in space inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but sends his first-time shot over the bar.
49' Joan Jordan (Sevilla) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
48' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias has a clear sight and sees a foul from Joan Jordan (Sevilla).
47' Gavi (Barcelona) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) threads a pass through to Robert Lewandowski, but Orjan Nyland breaks up the move.
46' Referee Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+2' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) attempts to send in a cross from the free kick, but it lacks accuracy and the ball goes out of play.
45' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle. Erik Lamela (Sevilla) commits a foul after dangerous play.
44' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
42' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Marc-Andre ter Stegen intercepts the ball.
41' A long pass, executed by Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
40' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it to the middle of the goal, but Orjan Nyland makes a comfortable save to stop his effort.
38' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) takes the free kick and sends the ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready.
37' Problems for Xavi as Raphinha (Barcelona) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Fermin Lopez replaces him.
35' The game is interrupted now, Raphinha (Barcelona) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
34' Raphinha (Barcelona) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his shot goalwards, but the keeper produces a decent save!
34' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Lucas Ocampos, but Marc-Andre ter Stegen displays great awareness to stop him.
32' Marc-Andre ter Stegen leaps to intercept the corner kick from Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla).
31' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Marc-Andre ter Stegen.
30' What a great touch by Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the right side of the goal, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.
28' Gavi (Barcelona) sends a long through ball to Raphinha, but he fails to control it properly and loses it to one of the defending players.
28' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) leaps highest to connect with the corner, but aims his close-range header well wide of the right post.
27' Raphinha (Barcelona) is about to take a corner kick.
27' Raphinha (Barcelona) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
25' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
24' Referee Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias sees the trip by Raphinha (Barcelona) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.

24' Raphinha (Barcelona) attempted to send a defence-splitting pass into space where Robert Lewandowski was lurking. It could have put him one-on-one with the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players somehow manages to avert the threat.
23' Dangerous play by Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla). Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle for a foul.
22' Joao Felix (Barcelona) gathers the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot. The ball only crashes against the crossbar.
21' The ball is cleared after Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

20' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) wasted a huge opportunity! He received a fine cross from the free kick and fired a decent shot in from close range. Unfortunately for him, it sailed narrowly wide of the left post!
19' Sevilla are awarded a free kick.
19' Gavi (Barcelona) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
18' Joao Felix (Barcelona) tries to find Robert Lewandowski, but he puts too much power on the pass.
17' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla). Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
17' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.

16' Ivan Rakitic (Sevilla) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the top right corner, but Marc-Andre ter Stegen has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
15' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
15' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. Good work from Barcelona as they win a corner.

13' Joao Felix (Barcelona) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went low towards the middle of the target, but Orjan Nyland was alert and the score remained the same.
11' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) sends an accurate short pass. Lamine Yamal controls the ball with a fine first touch and is able to come up with a new attacking effort.
9' Barcelona seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
7' A quickly taken corner by Barcelona.
7' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
7' Gavi (Barcelona) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
5' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar.
5' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
4' Joao Felix (Barcelona) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
3' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
3' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
2' Sevilla enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
2' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
2' Joao Felix (Barcelona) finds Alejandro Balde with a nice pass so he can go on towards the goal.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Sevilla will kick-off.
Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias is the one to supervise the game today.
